scope.reference_price: Decimal close of BTCUSDT candle [as_of_time-4h,as_of_time), final before extraction
scope.outcome_price: Decimal close of BTCUSDT candle [as_of_time,as_of_time+4h), final before extraction
scope.direction_rule: positive return=BULLISH; negative return=BEARISH; exactly zero=FLAT with zero tolerance

temporal_policy.as_of_semantics: scheduled UTC instant after the corresponding 4h candle is final
temporal_policy.training_policy: no model/prompt/threshold fitting on collection-window outcomes; only the predeclared research-only dynamic-weight rule may use strictly prior matured outcomes

model_selection.rule: latest exact BTCUSDT/4h registry entry with APPROVED entry and approval receipt before collection_start

dynamic_weight_rule.source_records: one conflict-free agent assessment per paired_analysis_id from thesis_experiment_identity_v1 envelopes
dynamic_weight_rule.agent_score: BULLISH:+1 when 4h public return>0,-1 when return<0,0 when flat; BEARISH:+1 when return<0,-1 when return>0,0 when flat; NEUTRAL/UNAVAILABLE/REJECTED:0
dynamic_weight_rule.window: [as_of_time-180 calendar days,as_of_time), ordered by source as_of_time then paired_analysis_id
dynamic_weight_rule.maturity_cutoff: include only outcomes with outcome_available_at<as_of_time; boundary equality is excluded
dynamic_weight_rule.duplicate_policy: same paired_analysis_id and agent must be byte-identical or the proposal is UNAVAILABLE
dynamic_weight_rule.collection_window_use: permitted only for strictly prior matured outcomes under this frozen research-only rule; no model/prompt/threshold update

decision_extraction.common_function: every arm uses ResearchAblationDecisionFunction; production VerificationAgent, AnalysisRiskEngine and ManagerAgent are observed artifacts only and never determine the primary endpoint
decision_extraction.base_score: sum configured component weight times BULLISH:+1, NEUTRAL:0, BEARISH:-1; required unavailable=>UNAVAILABLE
decision_extraction.debate_layer: when enabled replace base score with (base_score+debate_score)/2; otherwise use base_score unchanged
decision_extraction.verification_layer: when enabled a false research evidence-verification mask=>REJECTED; otherwise preserve the same candidate
decision_extraction.weight_layer: static or predeclared dynamic weights enter only the common base-score formula
decision_extraction.safety: SELL and SHORT are disabled for every variant

primary_endpoint.name: all_attempt_directional_score
primary_endpoint.population: all scheduled attempts with a matured public close outcome
primary_endpoint.formula: BUY:+1 if Decimal return>0 else -1 if return<0 else 0; HOLD/NO_DECISION/UNAVAILABLE/REJECTED/runtime_failure:0; SELL is invalid
primary_endpoint.contrast_estimand: mean(treatment_score-control_score) over the same scheduled attempts

secondary_endpoints.decision_rate: count(BUY)/count(all scheduled attempts with public outcome), unit=ratio
secondary_endpoints.conditional_directional_accuracy: count(correct BUY)/count(BUY with public outcome), unit=ratio, null when denominator zero
secondary_endpoints.simulated_net_return: sum((paper_exit_equity-paper_entry_equity-fees-slippage)/paper_entry_equity), unit=ratio, paper records only, null without completed paper fills
secondary_endpoints.simulated_max_drawdown: max((running_peak_equity-current_equity)/running_peak_equity), unit=ratio, paper equity path only, null without path
secondary_endpoints.latency_ms: median observed end-to-end latency over non-null values, unit=milliseconds, with denominator
secondary_endpoints.observed_provider_cost: sum non-null observed cost grouped by exact currency; never currency-convert, with denominator
secondary_endpoints.publication_rule: no confirmatory claim; any formula change requires a new protocol version

analysis.missing_policy: variant-caused missing or failure scores zero in primary ITT; missing public outcome is a null slot retained in its original calendar block and excluded from the main mean denominator for every variant
sensitivity: for each missing public outcome set treatment=-1 and control=+1 in every primary contrast
complete-case BUY decisions reported secondary only

dependence.block_unit: 42 fixed calendar slots anchored at collection_start; gaps remain null and the final block may be short
dependence.main_denominator: count non-null public-outcome slots; block sums ignore null slots without compressing time
dependence.bootstrap_null_rule: sample whole fixed-slot blocks; retain nulls; compute each replicate mean over sampled non-null slots; redraw an all-null replicate

inference.interval: circular moving-block bootstrap: sample start indexes uniformly with replacement, take 42 clocks with wraparound, concatenate and truncate to N, two-sided 2.5/97.5 percentiles
inference.test: partition chronologically into non-overlapping 42-clock blocks anchored at collection_start, retain final short block, randomly flip each block-sum sign, statistic=absolute overall mean, two-sided p=(1+count(permuted>=observed))/(10000+1)

analysis.information_target: census of every scheduled 4h decision in the fixed collection window
analysis.minimum_completeness: at least 90% of scheduled clocks have public outcomes and all ten attempted variant records
analysis.stopping_rule: no efficacy stopping; stop only at collection_end_exclusive or a documented safety/legal hard blocker

execution_readiness.required_adapter: A future versioned adapter must materialize exact research-only omitted-stage semantics without instantiating production ManagerAgent for without_verification and must persist thesis_experiment_identity_v1 with protocol, variant, config, cohort and paired-analysis identity
